name: ppq-question-curation
description: Source-backed question curation, provenance-aware PPQ packaging, and account-approved canonical question bank signatures.

interface.shortDescription: Collect, verify and organise exam questions.
interface.longDescription: Collect matching question papers and mark schemes, preserve original wording and metadata, prepare PPQ question banks including teacher essay puzzles, and request a canonical publisher signature through the existing PPQ account. Includes PDF evidence checks, provenance validation and lossless round-trip checks. MetaSo is optional; ordinary curation does not need a PPQ account.
defaultPrompt: 用 $exam-question-curation 整理指定年份与科目的历年真题，核验同卷评分标准，并按实际出现频率生成学习表。
用 $exam-question-curation 将已核验题目扩展为 PPQ 题库，保留全部 metadata、历史修订和原图。
